title: My documents
intro: Prescriptions, sick notes, referral letters and lab requests from your visits. Each one has a code anyone can check.
emptyBody: When a doctor signs a prescription, letter or sick note for you, it appears here.
codeHint: Under the QR code on the paper. Number {{number}}.
newVersion: This is version {{n}}. Earlier printouts are out of date.

share.title: Share with someone
share.intro: Make a link for an employer, a school or another doctor. It opens only this document and stops working when it expires.
share.once: Copy it now: we show it only once.

verify.title: Verify a document
verify.intro: Type the code printed under the QR code.
verify.notFoundBody: Check the code again. A document that is not found may be forged.
verify.limited: Too many checks. Wait a minute and try again.
verify.notValid: This document is no longer valid
verify.author: Signed by
verify.version: Version {{n}}: a newer version replaced the first printout.
verify.detailsIntro: To see what it says, give the patient's date of birth.
verify.dobMismatch: That date of birth doesn't match this document.

shared.title: Shared document
shared.goneBody: It expired or the patient stopped it. Ask them for a new link.
